name: wake
description: Wake Commerce for agents — Storefront catalog (search, product detail, recommendations, shipping), Admin orders and dashboard aggregates for analytics, and product variant images.

metadata.short_description: Search a Wake storefront catalog and analyze store orders.
metadata.mesh_description: The Wake Commerce MCP gives AI agents access to Wake (fbits); everything is read-only except product images. **Storefront (catalog)** — full-text product **search** with facet aggregations and price ranges; explicit product **listing** by id, sku, ean, category, brand, price and attributes; rich product **detail** with variants, prices and reviews; **autocomplete**; product **recommendations**; **hotsite** (category / landing page) resolution; variant **options**; **buy lists** (kits); **shipping quotes**; and store metadata. **Admin (orders / analytics)** — list store **orders** by date range, status, payment method, customer, SKU or ids, with totals and an **analytics projection without personal data**; fetch order **detail** and **status history**; list **order statuses**, **payment methods** and **order origins**; **dashboard aggregates** (revenue, orders and average ticket per hour/day, payment methods, best sellers, abandoned carts); **distribution centers** and **physical stores**. Admin calls are paced per token and stop after a 429 until Retry-After. **Admin (product images)** — list, upload and delete the images of a product **variant**, which changes the live store. **Authentication** — Storefront token (TCS-Access-Token header) for catalog tools; Admin API token (Basic auth) for order and image tools. Perfect for shopping assistants, catalog explorers and sales/order analytics on top of Wake Commerce.
